graph.title: IKEA GRÅFJÄLLET bedside table

steps.title: Start the side panels
steps.instruction: Lay the metal frame flat on a protected surface. Slide the first side panel down into the grooves, align the holes, and fasten it with two of the round-head screws.
warnings: Assemble on a soft surface to avoid damage.

steps.title: Add the second side panel
steps.instruction: Fit the second side panel into the opposite grooves the same way. Make sure it sits fully down in the frame, then secure it with two more round-head screws.

steps.title: Turn the frame and secure it
steps.instruction: Carefully roll the assembly over as shown so the panels stay in their grooves. Fasten the lower panel edges with four round-head screws, keeping the frame square.

steps.title: Slide in and lock the back panel
steps.instruction: Slide the back panel into the open side, matching the shaped edges shown in the drawing. Press the four side locks until they click into the locked position.

steps.title: Install the front panel
steps.instruction: Drop the front panel into the remaining opening, again matching the shaped top and bottom edges. Press the four locking tabs so the panel is held firmly.

steps.title: Attach the top frame to the body
steps.instruction: Set the body upright onto the top frame as shown, aligning the four corner holes. Use the Allen key to tighten four threaded bolts through the frame.

steps.title: Fit the adjustable feet
steps.instruction: Screw one adjustable foot into each of the four leg ends. After all four are installed, carefully turn the bedside table upright onto its feet.

steps.title: Prepare the door
steps.instruction: Lay the door flat with the inside facing up. Attach the handle with two screws, add the small screw and washer near the top corner, then press the bumper into its hole.

steps.title: Choose the door direction and add the lower hinge pin
steps.instruction: Choose which way the door will open. This build follows the first option shown; the other option is mirrored. Press the lower hinge pin into the front hole on the table frame.

steps.title: Hang and lock the door
steps.instruction: Lower the door onto the hinge pin so the bottom corner sits on it. Slide the hinge fitting up into the top corner and push it inward until it clicks locked.

steps.title: Close and level the table
steps.instruction: Swing the door closed and check that it sits evenly in the opening. Turn the four adjustable feet up or down until the table stands level and steady, and remember the maximum load is 25 kilograms.
warnings: Do not sit on the table or place heavy objects over 25 kg on it.

notes: Assemble the GRÅFJÄLLET bedside table frame, panels, shelf, legs, feet, and hinged door, with the option to mount the door opening either direction.
Delicate table: do not sit on the product.
Do not place heavy objects on this product. Maximum load is 25 kg, or 55 lb.
Use a screwdriver, not a knife, for opening or assembly.
Protect the parts by assembling on a soft surface such as a rug or the cardboard packaging.
If parts are missing or confusing, contact IKEA rather than forcing assembly.
